format: Unified diff conformance vectors. Core (Diff.test.ts) and Rust (widget/diff.rs) run this file. A row is [name, diff, shown, coreDefect?].
shown is "error" when the diff view shows a parse error. Otherwise it lists the hunks of the first file, each as its lines with their sign.
A blank line inside a hunk is the context line " ". `\ No newline at end of file` markers are left out.
Lines after a hunk's counts, up to the next hunk or file, are ignored, as `git apply` and GNU `patch` ignore them.
coreDefect names a known Core defect that gives another result; Core runs that row as test.todo until it is fixed.
